name: cubex
description: Self-hosted AI spreadsheet: AI columns, HTTP API enrichment, webhooks, and an MCP server for agents.

scripts.dev: npm run prebuild:server && concurrently "npm run dev:tsc" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
